subject.title: [Bug]: Chrome MCP existing-session `profile=user` reports ready but all page tools time out on macOS

question: For macOS signed-in-browser automation, should OpenClaw continue treating Chrome MCP `profile=user` page-tool reliability as a supported bug to fix, or should maintainers steer this workflow to the restored Chrome extension profile and document Chrome MCP as limited in this state?
rationale: Current code has partial diagnostic and timeout fixes, but the remaining symptom depends on live macOS Chrome/Chrome DevTools MCP behavior and on the intended signed-in-browser support boundary.

options.title: Run live macOS repro and keep Chrome MCP supported
options.body: Capture status, tabs, snapshot, screenshot, and evaluate traces on current main, then fix or upstream-report the exact Chrome MCP failure while preserving `pageReady` diagnostics.

options.title: Document Chrome MCP limitation and recommend extension profile
options.body: If the permission-gated Chrome MCP path is too unstable for signed-in sessions, document the unsupported state and steer users to the Chrome extension profile for real user-session workflows.

options.title: Sponsor the broad capability PR after owner review
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/85993 only if Browser/security owners accept its wider capability and security boundary changes as the desired fix path.

recommendation.title: Run live macOS repro and keep Chrome MCP supported
recommendation.body: Capture status, tabs, snapshot, screenshot, and evaluate traces on current main, then fix or upstream-report the exact Chrome MCP failure while preserving `pageReady` diagnostics.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue is already assigned to steipete and recent browser-plugin history shows him carrying adjacent Browser support and documentation decisions.
